summary: Completed backend+frontend verification for fixed assets module across both organizations. Core requested fixed-asset workflows passed (card visibility, categories/rates, create asset, auto purchase/depreciation journals, chart accounts linkage, trial balance reflection, admin delete cascade, and module toggle/route guard). critical.issue: Public preflight still returns access-control-allow-origin='*' and misses access-control-allow-credentials=true, conflicting with credentialed auth cookie/session posture.

Re-validate CORS at public endpoint level (not only backend middleware) using browser preflight requests.

Code review confirms auth cookie is set HttpOnly and brute-force lockout exists (5 failed attempts => temporary lock).
Admin seed flow updates existing admin password hash when ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD changes (idempotent update path present).
Egyptian e-invoice authority integration remains MOCKED/internal and was not validated against a live external authority endpoint in this run.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All fixed_assets module toggles were restored to enabled at end of UI run. Repro for remaining issue: send OPTIONS to public /api/auth/login with Origin+Access-Control-Request-* headers; response still shows wildcard origin and no allow-credentials.
